title: Ya-Sin 36:53-56 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:53-56 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 31. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ (٥٣) فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ (٥٤) إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ (٥٥) هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ (٥٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Ikhfa': noon before ك, then before ت
Idgham without ghunnah: tanween into ل

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:53-56 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:53-56 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:53-56 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.
All are brought before Allah; then the people of Paradise are in joy.

questions.q: 36:54 says they are recompensed only for what they used to do. What does that teach about responsibility?
questions.a: Each person's own deeds decide the outcome; no one carries another's burden.

questions.q: What are the people of Paradise doing in 36:55?
questions.a: A) Busy with amusement and enjoyment. 36:55.

questions.q: Ya-Sin 36:54: «فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'Today no soul will be wronged at all' (36:54). Why is that comforting for someone who has been treated unfairly?
questions.a: Every injustice will be put right; Allah's justice is perfect.
